entities.summary: St. Thomas University is a Catholic, English-language liberal arts university located in Fredericton, New Brunswick, Canada. It is a primarily undergraduate university, offering bachelor degrees to approximately 1,700 students. Thomas is also home of the Frank McKenna Centre for Communications and Public Policy.
